data.title: Cafe, Bakery and Coffee Bar
data.summary: A realistic cafe and bakery inventory: espresso machines and grinders, counter and servery modules, pastry and refrigerated display, deck ovens and dough plant, cafe seating, terrace and shopfront, serviceware and baked goods.
data.description: Counter-level cafe and bakery equipment in one coherent modern realistic family. The espresso machines are built as real machines: a boiler body behind an open working recess, chromed group heads with locked-in portafilters and twin spouts, articulated steam wands with cool-touch sleeves, a hot water tap, slotted drip trays, pump and boiler gauges, per-group button pads, backflush paddles and railed cup warming decks. Grinders carry hoppers with gate collars, knurled burr adjustment rings, dosing chutes and portafilter forks. The bakery side runs a three deck oven with stone hearths behind glazed doors, steam vents and valve handles, a convection oven, a proofing cabinet, spiral and planetary mixers, dough divider, racks and troughs. Counter and servery modules tile on the stream 600 mm counter-run grid with counter-left and counter-right ports and a corner that turns the run; shopfront modules tile on a 1.2 m grid. Seating carries piped seat pads and welted upright back pads. All original CC0 geometry with no brands, logos or menu wording; chalkboard, A-board and menu faces are blank.

starterScene.description: A serving coffee bar built on the 600 mm counter-run grid: a straight run of counter modules turning through a corner, a till position with a POS terminal, the two group espresso machine with its grinders, knock box and tamper station, a curved glass pastry case and a refrigerated cake display facing the customer, an undercounter milk fridge, batch brewer, water boiler and cup warmer behind, and a condiment bar, water station and queue rail on the customer side. Static layout; no rig, collision or navigation data.
